== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Kyle_Katarns_Blaster_Rifle.png]]) shows the original text; the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-47-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-kylekatarnsblasterrifle-pre.gif]]) show the retitled PC-E2 text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013) (title still •Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Rebel Agent. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (two if Scoundrel's Luck on table). Character or Creature hit, and forfeit = 0, if destiny > defense value. Vehicle hit, if destiny -2 > defense value.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1281_47 (title set to •Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle)</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
